_about: The documentation each rule in rules.json relies on: URL, the date it was read, and the sentence relied on (quoted as returned by the fetch; the Linear schema is quoted from the file itself, see linear_schema_excerpt.txt). Third-party pages are not used.

slack-postmessage.quote: No argument sets the post time (the server returns ts). Bot token: chat:write; User token: chat:write. 'Slack App user token with chat:write:user inherits the icon and username of the token owner.' Blocks: 'A JSON-based array of structured blocks'. Threads: 'Provide a thread_ts value for the posted message to act as a reply to a parent message.'

slack-import.quote: Workspace Owners on Free, Pro, and Business+ plans can import. Imports public channels, their messages and members; users are merged by email, 'Import just their messages', or 'Import as deactivated'. The page does not say whether original timestamps or reactions are kept.

slack-import-faq.quote: 'Import messages, threads, and files to channels'; 'Pinned messages will be imported'; 'click the Reverse Import button to cancel and reverse an import'. Timestamps and reactions are not addressed.

slack-free.quote: 'You can view and search messages and files from the last 90 days.' 'You can add up to 10 third-party or custom apps.'

slack-guests.quote: 'Guest accounts are available only on paid plans.'

slack-profile.quote: Requires a user token (xoxp-) with users.profile:write. 'Your workspace must be on a paid plan to use the users.profile.set API method in order to change the profile for other users.' Settable: display_name, email, first_name, last_name, phone, pronouns, real_name, start_date, title (no time zone). 'You can change usernames and display names with a token that was generated by a Workspace Owner or Admin.'

slack-deactivate.quote: 'Owners and admins can deactivate members' accounts'; 'Available on all plans'; done in the admin UI (Workspace settings > People > Deactivate account); the member's content remains.

slack-open.quote: Bot tokens: im:write or mpim:write. 'Provide 1 to 8 user IDs in the users parameter'; 'Providing more than 1 will create a multi-person direct message (mpim).'

slack-pricing.quote: Pro: '$8.75 USD per user / month, when paying monthly' (then 50% off for 3 months); '$7.25 USD per user / month, when paying annually'.

linear-schema.quote: IssueCreateInput.createdAt: 'The time at which the issue was created (e.g. if importing from another system). Must be a time in the past.' IssueCreateInput.completedAt: 'Must be a time in the past and after createdAt.' CommentCreateInput.createdAt: 'Must be a time in the past.' No creator field outside createAsUser, 'only available to OAuth applications creating issues in actor=app mode'. Cycle.number: 'assigned automatically by the database and cannot be set on creation.' TeamMembershipCreateInput.owner: 'Internal.' DocumentCreateInput.teamId and .initiativeId: '[Internal]'. User.admin: 'On Free plans, all members are treated as admins.' See linear_schema_excerpt.txt.

linear-pricing.quote: Free: 'Unlimited members', '2 teams', '250 issues'. Basic '$10 per user/month': 'Admin roles'. Business '$16 per user/month' (billed yearly): 'Private teams and guests'; sub-teams '5 levels' on Business against '1 level' on Free/Basic.

box-upload.quote: Upload attributes: name, parent, content_created_at ('Defines the time the file was originally created at. If not set, the upload time will be used.'), content_modified_at. created_at is 'The date and time when the file was created on Box' (set by Box).

box-collections.quote: 'Currently, only the favorites collection is supported.' No endpoint creates a collection.

box-hubs.quote: 'Box Hubs endpoints require the box-version: 2025.0 header.' Requires 'A Box account with Box Hubs enabled for your enterprise'. The API can create, list, update, delete and copy hubs and add or remove items.

box-hubs-plans.quote: Box Hubs is available for 'Enterprise and Enterprise Plus customers'.

box-free-dev.quote: '10 GB storage, a 250 MB file upload limit, and 1 file version'; 'OAuth 2.0, JWT, and Client Credentials Grant (CCG) authentication'; 'not every endpoint is available on this plan'; multi-user administration is a paid-plan feature.

box-as-user.quote: The application must be 'configured to perform actions as users in the Developer Console'; 'The authenticated user needs to be a user with admin permissions, meaning either an admin, co-admin, or service account.'

gcal-events.quote: eventType: 'This cannot be modified after the event is created.' organizer: 'Read-only, except when importing an event.' creator: 'Read-only.' created/updated: read-only. iCalUID 'must be supplied when importing events via the import method'. hangoutLink: 'Read-only.' attendees[].resource: 'Can only be set when the attendee is added to the event for the first time.'

gcal-event-types.quote: 'These features are only available on primary calendars, and to some Google Calendar users.' Focus time, out of office and working location events must be on a user's primary calendar.

gcal-focus-help.quote: 'To schedule a focus time event, you must have a work or school account' (Workspace Business Standard and Plus, Enterprise, Education, Nonprofits); not personal accounts.

gcal-calendars.quote: dataOwner: 'The email of the owner of the calendar. Set only for secondary calendars. Read-only.' calendars.insert: 'The authenticated user for the request is made the data owner of the new calendar.'

gcal-calendarlist.quote: hidden, selected, summaryOverride: writable. accessRole: 'The effective access role that the authenticated user has on the calendar. Read-only.'

gcal-acl.quote: scope.type: 'default', 'user', 'group' ('Limits the scope to a group'), 'domain'. Roles: none, freeBusyReader, reader, writerWithoutPrivateAccess, writer, owner.

gcal-resources.quote: Rooms are Admin SDK Directory calendar resources of a Workspace customer (POST .../customer/{customer}/resources/calendars); creating them needs the 'Buildings and resources administrator' privilege.

gworkspace-pricing.quote: Business Starter '$7.00 / user per month'; Business Standard '$14.00 / user per month'; 'Try Google Workspace for 14 days'.

box-ownership.quote: 'The Owner of the parent destination folder becomes the Owner of the newly moved folder.' Collaborators of the destination folder inherit access.

box-file.quote: uploader_display_name: 'The display name of the user that uploaded the file. In most cases this is the name of the user logged in at the time of the upload.' created_by: 'The user who created this file.' owned_by: 'The user who owns this file.' created_at: 'The date and time when the file was created on Box.' content_created_at: 'The date and time at which this file was originally created, which might be before it was uploaded to Box.'

google-oauth-testing.quote: 'A Google Cloud Platform project with an OAuth consent screen configured for an external user type and a publishing status of Testing is issued a refresh token expiring in 7 days, unless the only OAuth scopes requested are a subset of name, email address, and user profile.'

slack-skills.quote: 'placeholder tokens like <TOKEN> where credentials would go'; 'handled automatically via proxy.'
